scan_noise_mm.method: rms of RANSAC+SVD plane on mounting-tab top face (moulded flat, parallel to the back floor, 18.9 mm above it) (1638 faces)

primary.mesh_region_desc: back cover floor (flat rear face inside the rim wall)
primary.why: the back cover is the board plane: the three button axes, the screw-boss holes and the connector shroud are all normal to it; largest clean moulded flat (logos excluded by the RANSAC trim)

secondary.mesh_region_desc: middle button collar (housing bore boss around the espresso-2-cups button)
secondary.why: housing feature that guides the middle button; the part is mirror-symmetric about it (side buttons at +/-27 mm). The loose button cap itself sits 1.6 deg tilted in its bore and is rougher (circle rms 0.03-0.08), so it is not used as the datum
secondary.fit_metric: median / worst circle residual over stations (kasa)

noise_ref.method: median IRLS circle rms over the 9 origin stations of the middle button collar (z -18.7..-16.4); SELF-REFERENTIAL (same surface as the origin fit), declared
noise_ref.note: single-station circle noise on the collar (z=-17.5) was 0.0266 vs the 9-station median 0.0294: a tie within estimator precision (skill defect D1, evals/real-runs/OD-H22.md). The collar residual sits inside the range of the other clean circles on this scan (0.0105-0.0393), so it is not warp or artefact.

clock.rule: plane_normal: +X end face of the housing rim/steps (end nearest the steam button) -> +X
clock.why: the housing long axis (line of the three buttons) is X; the end walls are its normals

tilt_deg.method: common slope, per-feature intercept, 9 stations over 1 feature(s), z -18.700..-16.400 vs frame Z

per_feature.feature: middle button collar (housing bore boss around the espresso-2-cups button)

origin.definition: middle button collar axis ∩ back cover floor plane

sanity_landmarks.name: mounting tab top face (highest point)
sanity_landmarks.tol_source: planes survey peak bin (0.1 mm) + 2x noise floor

sanity_landmarks.name: middle button top face centre (median, r<3 mm)
sanity_landmarks.tol_source: planes survey peak bin (-29.05 provisional frame, +0.07 frame offset) + 2x noise floor

CHK-TILT.note: common slope, per-feature intercept, 9 stations over 1 feature(s), z -18.700..-16.400 vs frame Z; reference 0.3 deg (RE_SPEC.md:241, report-only)

CHK-SCALE.note: FLAG: no caliper or operator dimensions (scan-only, DECISIONS.md MEASUREMENTS). Units assumed mm, scale unverified; no scale applied.

note: matrix_4x4 maps the RAW scan to the datum frame, row-major; scale_factor is folded in (T @ S, run-contract SS11). aligned_work.stl is exported at the scaled size (unchanged).
